Name: 0rg's Advancing Sprinklers (Content Patcher)
Author: 0rganics
Description:
[size=5]What is?[/size]
This mod changes the recipes for the Quality Sprinkler and Iridium Sprinkler, so that those recipes require the previous tier of Sprinkler to be crafted. This does not affect game balance (if anything it makes it slightly harder due to increased material cost of higher tiers overall), but it does give a reason to craft and use simple sprinklers in the early game without leaving them to rot in a chest in the late game.

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
This mod requires SMAPI (tested with v2.8+) and Content Patcher (tested with v1.5.3)

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]



[size=5]Shoutouts[/size]
Shoutouts to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/30094255]warix3[/url], the author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2983]Advancing Sprinkers[/url], which inspired this mod. None of the original mod's code was used, this is a scratch-build mod recreating the same effect as a Content Patcher mod.
